users_active_requires_credential.name: users_active_requires_credential
users_active_requires_credential.value: "users"."status" <> 'active' OR "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."mfa_secret_ref" IS NOT NULL

user_roles_scope_shape.name: user_roles_scope_shape
user_roles_scope_shape.value:
("user_roles"."scope_type" = 'platform' AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."org_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("user_roles"."scope_type" = 'reseller' AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_roles"."org_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("user_roles"."scope_type" IN ('organization','workspace','team') AND "user_roles"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_roles"."org_id" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_keys_completed_shape.name: idempotency_keys_completed_shape
idempotency_keys_completed_shape.value: "idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("idempotency_keys"."response_status_code" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
